title: Jagged Smoky Moroccan Sloe Berries Briouat
description: A spicy and fluffy Moroccan dish featuring sloe berries, smoke, and egg-free friendly ingredients, formed into briouat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, smoked paprika, granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sloe berries and coconut oil.
Add the sloe berry mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Gradually add the water to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few sloe berries in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the briouat on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
